title: Oracle Essbase User
description: An Oracle Essbase user account with role-based access control. Users are assigned service roles (User, Power User, or Service Administrator) and can belong to groups for simplified permission management.

id.description: Unique user identifier used for login and API references.

name.description: User display name. Maximum 256 characters. Special characters not permitted: ; , = + * ? [ ] | < > \ " ' / space tab.

email.description: User email address for notifications and account recovery.

password.description: User password. Write-only; not returned in API responses.

role.description: Service-level role determining the user's base permissions. User has read access. Power User can create and manage applications. Service Administrator has full administrative control.

token.description: Authentication token for the user session.

groups.description: List of group names the user belongs to.

type.description: Media type of the linked resource.
